name: Muong Thanh bridge
kicker: The Bailey span over the Nam Rom
summary: Cross the bridge the 2022 route page says the French called Bailey, over the Nậm Rốm between the central sector and the eastern hills. That page prints 40 m by 5 m. The handbook does not. A bridge ticket was not printed. Check on arrival, and do not assume the relic point fee applies.
timeNeeded: A few minutes on the span
getThere: A walk in the center, beside the De Castries bunker. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The truss span, the Nậm Rốm, and the basin bank

notice.title: The museum ticket is not this bridge
notice.body: The four named electronic-receipt points do not include the bridge. Do not assume the relic’s 20,000 VND point fee applies, and do not budget a museum hour for a span the route page says people still use.

body: The 2022 route page says the French called this bridge Bailey. It was built over the Nậm Rốm to link the central sector and the eastern hills. That page prints the length as 40 m and the width as 5 m, and says the soldiers crossed it on the afternoon of 7 May 1954. The handbook names the bridge beside the De Castries bunker and does not print 40 m or 5 m. The measurements stay on the route page. The handbook’s catalog puts the bridge at phường Mường Thanh, thành phố Điện Biên Phủ. That ward is inside phường Điện Biên Phủ from 1 July 2025.

You cross it. The route page says people still use it as a road. A few minutes on the span, then the bunker if both are the plan. A posted visit length was not printed. Check on arrival. The 17:30 flag on the bunker and the 15:00 attack order at Mường Phăng are two moments on 7 May 1954. Neither is a clock for this bridge. Pair the span with the bunker during the relic day hours if the bunker is the other half of the stop. The bridge itself is the road.

figures.caption: Crossing the truss span, with the far bank and the river below
figures.alt: A rider crossing the Muong Thanh truss bridge over the Nam Rom in Dien Bien Phu

gettingThere: The span is in the center of the basin, across the Nậm Rốm, near the De Castries bunker. Walk from a hotel in phường Điện Biên Phủ. Minutes were not printed. Check on arrival. A taxi fare inside the ward was not printed either. The airport transfer fares are not a fare for this crossing.

legs.heading: From the basin ward
legs.body: On foot, in the center. The handbook puts the bridge beside the bunker. A published minute count from a central hotel is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the De Castries bunker
legs.body: The handbook names the bridge as something you can see from the bunker stop. Walk across. Minutes between the two were not printed. Check on arrival. The bunker follows the relic day hours, shut from 11:00 to 13:30. The span is a road outside that gate.

hours: The 2022 route page says people still use the bridge. A posted clock for the span alone was not printed. Check on arrival. If the bunker is part of the same stop, the relic day hours are 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–18:00 from 1 March to 30 September, and 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:30 from 1 October to 28 February.
closed: No weekly close was printed for the span. The bunker beside it is shut from 11:00 to 13:30 on the relic calendar. The March 2026 notice does not add a night opening at the bunker.
admissionNote: A bridge ticket was not printed. Check on arrival. The four named electronic-receipt points are the monument, Hill A1’s night line in the newspaper, the De Castries bunker, and the Mường Phăng headquarters. The bridge is not in that list. Do not assume the 20,000 VND relic point fee applies. The museum’s 100,000 VND ticket and the tourism desk’s 5,000 VND line are not this span.
